reviews.t: Great product. I have been using this for about ...
reviews.x: Great product.  I have been using this for about 4 months and I love it. I have a combination-oily skin and have to be so careful what I use as I will break out even though I am nearly 70. I use this as a face and neck moisturizer twice a day, not just on my eyes, and my skin is looking firmer. I also look for the ingredients of a product and the fewer, the better. claims.text: Many reviewers love the pump/dispenser design, saying it dispenses the right amount and avoids wasting product.
Reviewers commonly report the cream moisturizes well, absorbs quickly, and leaves skin soft and smooth.
Several reviewers say they see improvements around the eyes, such as softened fine lines, reduced dark circles, or firmer skin.
Some reviewers with sensitive skin report stinging or burning, though one notes the company stood behind the product.
A few reviewers find it too greasy for the whole face, recommending it mainly for the eye area.
